Reject the artifact, compare against the approved manifest, investigate mutation and require digest-bound approval before promotion.
Block ingestion, complete supplier and source due diligence, verify licensing and provenance, and approve the source before use.
Review data classification, output filtering, minimization and retention; confirm exposure scope and privacy escalation.

Compare deployed configuration with approved baseline, investigate unauthorized change and restore policy-as-code controls.
